name: Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu - § 34 - Am 19
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 34. Invites the Commission and Member States to recognise the essential role of nutrition as a key determinant in cancer prevention, treatment response, disease progression and the long-term management of cancer conditions and to promote, including by proposing online and offline awareness measures, healthy, evidence-based dietary patterns, promoting healthy eating habits and a balanced diet including all essential nutrients, and characterised by the balanced consumption of animal proteins, fruits and vegetables as well as regular physical activity, as a core component of cancer prevention strategies; recalls that balanced healthy diets such as traditional European dietary patterns, including the Mediterranean and Nordic diets, should be encouraged;
